WITH selected_flights AS (SELECT * FROM aviation.flights WHERE scheduled_departure >= DATE '2025-08-01' AND scheduled_departure < DATE '2025-08-08'), sold AS (SELECT tf.flight_id, COUNT(*) AS sold_count FROM aviation.ticket_flights AS tf JOIN selected_flights AS sf ON sf.flight_id = tf.flight_id GROUP BY tf.flight_id), boarded AS (SELECT bp.flight_id, COUNT(*) AS boarded_count FROM aviation.boarding_passes AS bp JOIN selected_flights AS sf ON sf.flight_id = bp.flight_id GROUP BY bp.flight_id) SELECT f.flight_id, COALESCE(s.sold_count, 0) AS sold_count, COALESCE(b.boarded_count, 0) AS boarded_count, COALESCE(b.boarded_count, 0)::numeric / NULLIF(s.sold_count, 0) AS ratio FROM selected_flights AS f LEFT JOIN sold AS s ON s.flight_id = f.flight_id LEFT JOIN boarded AS b ON b.flight_id = f.flight_id

SELECT w.region, SUM(i.quantity) AS stock, SUM(i.reserved_quantity) AS reserved FROM retail.inventory i JOIN retail.warehouses w ON w.warehouse_id = i.warehouse_id JOIN retail.products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id WHERE p.category_id = 19 GROUP BY w.region ORDER BY stock DESC

SELECT carrier, shipment_status, COUNT(*) AS shipments, AVG(delivered_at - shipped_at) AS avg_delivery_time FROM retail.shipments WHERE carrier = 'LocalPost' AND shipped_at IS NOT NULL AND (delivered_at IS NULL OR delivered_at - shipped_at > INTERVAL '24 hours') GROUP BY carrier, shipment_status ORDER BY shipments DESC

SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count, MIN(ordered_at) AS first_order, MAX(ordered_at) AS last_order FROM retail.customer_orders WHERE ordered_at >= DATE '2024-06-23' - INTERVAL '365 days' AND order_status = 'delivered' GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3 ORDER BY order_count DESC, last_order DESC LIMIT 300

SELECT ordered_at::date AS day, COUNT(*) AS orders, SUM(total_amount) AS revenue, AVG(discount_amount) AS avg_discount FROM retail.customer_orders WHERE sales_channel = 'mobile' AND ordered_at >= DATE '2023-05-29' - INTERVAL '90 days' AND ordered_at < DATE '2023-05-29' + INTERVAL '90 days' AND order_status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY ordered_at::date ORDER BY day
